verdict.rationale: Edge0 runs without a GUI: `edge0 serve` exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint you can curl, and there is a one-shot CLI chat mode, a macOS CLI/daemon, and a Python `AutoEngine` API. These cover headless server-style use. missing for 10: explicit Linux/server deployment docs (the listed platforms are macOS, Windows, iOS and Android, and the CUDA backend is only a reserved slot), container/daemonization guidance for servers, CI-pipeline usage docs beyond weightless unit tests, and independent hands-on corroboration.
